summary: iter321: Verified TWILIO_VERIFY_SID dead-env-var cleanup. Confirmed (1) /app/backend/.env no longer contains a TWILIO_VERIFY_SID line, only TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE_SID; (2) zero source references to TWILIO_VERIFY_SID across /app/backend/**/*.py (and globally /app/**/*.py); (3) GET /api/twilio/config returns configured=true, can_mint_tokens=true, can_place_calls=true, missing=[]; (4) POST /api/twilio/token successfully mints a 3-part JWT; (5) get_verify_service_sid() returns SID when env var present and raises RuntimeError mentioning 'TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE_SID' when popped. Regression: ran all 5 iter316 backend pytest files — 47/47 effective pass, 9 skips (auth rate-limit acceptable). 2 transient 429 failures during the first regression run were re-run after 75s cooldown and passed cleanly, confirming they are platform-level rate-limiting and not a regression caused by the cleanup.
